title: A depth lower bound over a Cohen-Macaulay closed fibre of a flat local homomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the depth of an ideal in a flat local extension of Noetherian local rings from below by the difference of the dimension of the Cohen-Macaulay closed fibre and that of its quotient by the ideal (author lemma at source lines 2093-2102, label lemma-depth-flat-CM). The proof (source lines 2104-2109) lifts regular sequences from the closed fibre to the ring, which reduces the statement to the case of a field base, where it becomes the cited depth-dimension inequality for Cohen-Macaulay rings. The reduction to the field case is the substance. H2.
